decisions.reason: As an organic yogurt closely tied to our dairy know-how and already validated by an award, it fits our knowledge base well and gives us strong grounds to keep and further exploit it.
This flavored organic cheese is a nearby extension of our existing cheese capabilities, and its home-page promotion suggests enough early promise to justify continued learning and market support.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is firmly within our established competencies, so even with limited visible feedback we would usually keep it long enough to gather more sales and customer learning.
Spicy cheese is still close to our core cheese expertise, but the narrower taste profile and lack of strong early signals make it somewhat more exposed while still worth retaining for now.
The mild creamy soft cheese broadens our range within a familiar technical area, and the explicit launch support indicates sufficient strategic fit to continue rather than withdraw quickly.

Washed-rind soft cheese builds on our cheese-making knowledge, but because it is a more niche style and shows no clear early success signal, it has the highest risk of withdrawal despite being kept for now.
